name: Miss Hooch Archive
description: Phosphor Archive design: Terminal and cyber-blue skins, an alphabetical index, a status bar with a music player, photo effects driven by Obsidian image embeds, marginalia and a restyled graph.
author: Miss Hooch

settings.name: Homepage marquee text
settings.description: The large stretched line that scrolls across the homepage.
settings.default: STILL HERE? // ARE YOU EXPANDING YOUR MIND? // NOTHING HERE IS FINISHED //

settings.name: Featured tag
settings.description: Notes with this tag appear under 'featured writing' on the homepage. Add the tag in Obsidian, no code needed.

settings.name: Homepage portrait
settings.description: Path of the photo shown on the homepage and on the ID card. Leave empty for none.

settings.name: ID card status
settings.description: The STATUS line on the homepage ID card.

settings.name: Site-wide playlist
settings.description: Tracks for the player on every page. Format: Title|https://link-to-file.mp3; Title|https://another.mp3. Leave empty to use the built-in generated ambient track.

settings.name: Homepage dialog title
settings.description: Title bar of the dialog box on the homepage.

settings.name: Homepage dialog text
settings.description: Message inside the homepage dialog box.
